messages:
Maria (ML): quick flag  new q4/int4 bring-up on promptset_v7_long shows a quality drop on long-prefix code and stepwise instruction summarization. ~8% drop vs baseline float32 on our golden eval. need quick triage.
Zhen: ok, what's the exact eval command and configs you ran?
Maria (ML): ran three configs: q4_int4_kv (default kvcache), q4_int4_no_kv, and q8_int3 control. eval command:
```
run_eval --model=redwood-q4b-int4 --prompts=promptset_v7_longprefix.json --gold=gold_v3.json --metrics=exact_match,rouge,f1 --batch-size=8
```
Maria (ML): attached failure_ids.csv (28 ids). lots of micro-paraphrases and some deid token substitutions. could be dedupe or tokenizer edgecases.
Lia: i'll take labeling triage. plan: 1) dedupe pass (fuzzy_threshold=0.85) to collapse near-dupes, 2) reserve 50 examples stratified by prompt_length and code_token_count, 3) run label job pairwise (float32 vs q4). label schema: ok/partial/bad + 1-line note for partials. sound good?
Ajay (Infra): i'll spin ephemeral GPU tomorrow morning 08:00 PST (p4d). reserved /gpu/ephemeral-12. infra ticket INF-2026-341 created.
Zhen: repro tip: try forcing kernel compatibility: `export REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat` and toggle kv with `--kv-cache=off`. also enable `--trace-kv` to log kv hit/miss per token. if kernel_mode fix reduces regression it's a kernel selection issue.
Lia: starting dedupe now with `python dedupe.py --threshold 0.85 --keep=longer` then will post sample IDs.
LabelerBot: Assigned batch 2026-03-24-02 -> Lia, 50 examples, est 8h.
Zhen: i repro locally with kernel_mode=compat: regression drops to ~1.2% on longprefix set. looks like kernel pick for int4 path is causing mismatch for long-context. i'll try pinning fallback kernels and run a smoke.
Maria (ML): if kernel pin fixes it, we might need a config override until runtime selection is patched. Lia, hold labels for examples that kernel pin fixes so we don't waste labeling. threshold: if >15% partial/bad in remaining set we escalate and pause rollout. baseline float32 had 3.2% partial/bad.
Lia: paused labeling pending Zhen's smoke. posting updated sample list in 30m. will also run a quick quant hyperparam smoke `--quant-mode=int4-highbias` to see sensitivity.
Ajay (Infra): keep me posted when you're done with runs; i'll tear down after 4h window. run link: https://infra/redwood/runs/ephemeral-12-smoke
LabelerBot: status -> in_progress (12/50 labeled). Lia: friendly reminder.
Maria (ML): once labels are in Lia, if confirmed real regressions update golden changelog with note `q4-int4-longprefix-2026-03-24` and mark examples to be added to golden-supplement. i'll draft triage doc summarizing kernel trace, kv hits, and label distribution.
Zhen: pushed PR with kernel pin prototype. i'll add KV trace logs to the smoke run so we can correlate specific tokens with cache misses.
Lia: will annotate labels with a kv-mismatch flag if we see prefix tokens replaced/missing. also adding a small checklist for labelers: 1) intent preserved? 2) missing steps? 3) hallucinated additions? 4) tokenization artifacts?
LabelerBot: paused assignment 2026-03-24-02 by Lia -> 12 labeled, 38 pending.
Maria (ML): thanks all 4dd we'll reconvene here after label pass and kernel fix smoke.
Lia: posting sample IDs now -> [list posted in thread attachments].
